Most taxpayers review Form 16 before filing their Income Tax Return.

But many skip an equally important document — Form 26AS.

Form 26AS is your consolidated tax statement and helps you verify information such as:

✔ TDS deducted by employers, banks, or other deductors

✔ TCS collected

✔ Advance tax payments

✔ Tax refund details

Think of it this way:

📄 Form 16 shows what your employer reported.

📊 Form 26AS shows what the Income Tax Department has received.

Before filing your ITR, take a few minutes to review Form 26AS and ensure the information matches your records.

A small check today can help avoid unnecessary mismatches tomorrow.
